name: RSS news
author: Marius Ghizdavet
description: An RSS reader in the Omarchy bar: the unread count, the items in a panel, mark-all-read, and feed management. Speaks 10 languages, following the system locale by default.

barWidget.description: Unread items from the RSS feeds you configure, each with its title, source and age.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Auto follows the system locale and falls back to English when it is not one of the translated languages.

schema.label: Refresh interval on mains power (seconds)
schema.description: The cadence used while the laptop runs on mains power — and always, on a desktop.

schema.label: Refresh interval on battery (seconds)
schema.description: Every refresh downloads every feed, so a slower cadence is worth it on battery.

schema.label: Show the count in the bar
schema.description: Turned off, the bar keeps only the icon.

schema.label: Show item thumbnails
schema.description: The illustration is fetched and checked by the plugin's own helper, then shown from a local cache; the panel itself never contacts the source site.

schema.label: Show unread items only
schema.description: Turned off, read items stay in the list, dimmed.

schema.label: Mark everything read when the panel closes
schema.description: On close, not on open, so the count does not drop to zero before you have seen what was new.
